sources.title: LiquidAI/lfm2.5-350m
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-350M LFM2.5 is a new family of hybrid models designed for on-device deployment. It builds on the LFM2 architecture with extended pre-training and reinforcement learning. Best-in-class performance: A 350M model rivaling much larger models, bringing high-quality AI to your pocket. Fast edge inference: 313 tok/s decode on AMD CPU, 188 tok/s on Snapdragon Gen4. sources.title: LFM2.5-350M: No Size Left Behind | Blog | Liquid AI
sources.snippet: Today, we're releasing LFM2.5-350M, an improved version of our 350M model with additional pre-training (from 10T to 28T tokens) and large-scale reinforcement learning. Built on the LFM2 architecture, it delivers exceptionally fast inference and runs everywhere, from cloud GPUs to cheap CPUs.
